## Foods & dishes
- [[RecipeDB2]]: ≈400 Norwegian recipes (region "Scandinavian"); not released. [[Food.com Recipes and Interactions]]: 199 tagged `norwegian`.
- Dish inventories: [[FmLAMA]] 17 dishes (181 rows; fårikål, rømmegrøt, kvæfjordkake); [[WorldCuisines]] 16 dishes (3 Norway-only; flatbrød, lefse, lutefisk). Ingredient lists only.

## Ingredients & food composition
- No national food composition table for this country is in the vault or `Backlog/`; use [[USDA FoodData Central]] (and [[FooDB]] / [[Phenol-Explorer]] for compounds) by name matching.
- Plants: [[CMAUP]] 119 plants.

## Compounds & traditional medicine
- **Human-cohort evidence:** [[Exposome-Explorer]] 1,183 rows (478 concentrations, 610 correlations, 30 cancer). MoBa (Norwegian Mother and Child Cohort) dominates; EPIC-Norway gives 21 of the cancer rows (overall mostly gastric/oesophageal 11 and colorectal 9).
- [[Dr. Duke's Phytochemical and Ethnobotanical Databases|Duke]] 10 records; [[KNApSAcK Family]] World lists the country (edible/medicinal species records; counts for European countries were not scraped).
- Global backbone via [[Global]]: [[FooDB]], [[Phenol-Explorer]], [[CTD]], [[SpiceRx]], [[DDID]] for food–drug interactions.

## Gaps
- No Norwegian FCT and no recipe corpus with amounts; fish-based dishes need composition from USDA.
